I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May date, so I'm treating it as unverified.

- **What I checked:** #central-team and the shared Central files, which Pree can see too. Neither has anything on Thornbury Cloth Co.: no account files, no order form and no signing date. I didn't look anywhere she can't see.
- **Date problem:** today is 14 October 2026, so 23 May has already passed this year. It's either May 2027 or something got garbled on the call.
- **Next step:** I suggested she check it with her Thornbury contact or whoever owns the account before anyone plans around it.

A signing deadline isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to discuss in the channel without approval.
